dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale grey edges are visible along the folded flight feathers, providing moderate contrast against the darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A discernible boundary is visible where the relatively uniform, pale plumage of the crown transitions into the high-contrast scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits a highly repetitive, high-contrast scalloped pattern across its dorsal plumage, characterized by dark feather centers with pale, semi-circular fringes.
